A '''dragon'''-like reptile found in the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] was a dangerous burrowing reptile that had a long body with [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin, an elongated snout with long sharp teeth, and red eyes. It would emerge above ground and snap its jaws at prey that passed by.

==Behind the scenes==
Unnamed in the game or its manual, these creatures were referred to as "dragons" and "dragon-like enemies" in a ''Nintendo Power'' magazine article detailing the ''[[Super Star Wars: Return of the Jedi]]'' video game.<ref name="NintendoPower">{{BookCite|container=''Super Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' - Trust in the Force|title=Nintendo Power|number=Volume 67|date=December 1994|link=https://archive.org/details/NintendoPowerMagazineTheSNESEra/Nintendo%20Power%20028%20%28Sep%201991%29%20Super%20Mario%20World/page/n1/mode/2up}}</ref>
